contract: Only a fully validated physical source bag and explicit deterministic integer sort/null laws can yield Exact. All other native/session laws remain conditional and require executed evidence; parser success is not native execution.

cases.sql: SELECT id, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id NULLS LAST) AS tile FROM s
SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM s
SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x NULLS LAST GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM s
SELECT id, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id NULLS LAST) AS tile FROM s QUALIFY NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id NULLS LAST) = 1

SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM s QUALIFY SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 20
SELECT id, NTILE(0) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id NULLS LAST) AS tile FROM s
cases.conditional_reason: Zero bucket count is not a valid NTILE cardinality; do not fabricate physical terminal rows.

cases.sql: SELECT id, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x NULLS LAST) AS tile FROM s
cases.conditional_reason: ORDER BY peers (ids 2 and 3, x=10) straddle NTILE(3) buckets 1 and 2 in the five-row k=0 partition, so the exact physical tile per id is unprovable without a total order.

cases.sql: SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM s
cases.conditional_reason: Explicit NULLS FIRST/LAST is required for portable physical ordering.

cases.sql: SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM s
cases.conditional_reason: Bounded numeric RANGE requires attested value-distance and overflow semantics.

cases.sql: SELECT id, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY x, id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM s
cases.conditional_reason: Composite ORDER BY preserves peer identity but engine-default NULL placement remains unattested.

cases.sql: SELECT id, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY CAST(x AS VARCHAR) COLLATE NOCASE) AS tile FROM s
cases.conditional_reason: Locale and collation rules on text-valued window order lack attested typed sort-key semantics; never choose exact peer identities.

conditional_registry.reason: The canonical source-attested evaluator accepts only integer ORDER BY comparators; CAST/COLLATE text order is explicitly a Residual, not an engine-independent exact rank.
Numeric RANGE offset direction/overflow and vendor rules require an expanded frozen physical execution oracle.
RANGE bounded offsets with multiple keys are not portable; GROUPS peers can use explicit ordered tuples.
All 13 parser dialects must be classified; parser evidence alone does not certify their engines.
Child implementation and green CI do not close independent original TASK-74 AC.

review.v5_critique: Review of PR #139 found the v4 NTILE tied-peer negative case did not cross a bucket boundary. v5 changes only the N2 source values to exercise genuine bucket-boundary ambiguity, adds independently executed ascending/descending DuckDB witnesses and an invariant-peer positive regression, stores native N3/N4/N5 expected bags as engine-specific frozen evidence, and asserts all parsed conditional dialect cells remain Residual. Original five mandatory Exact cases and six conditional case identities are unchanged.
